exports.verifyCommittedSchedulerEvidence: synchronous ({checkpointFile, expectedCommittedRevision, context, registry, registryEntry, repositoryRoot, expectedPayloadSchema})

schemas.payload: explicit expectedPayloadSchema from actual producer owner; not invented by this API

revisionSemantics: expectedCommittedRevision must independently name the persisted AFTER-write revision; attachCheckpointCurrentRunEvidence.expectedRevision names BEFORE-write baseline. Reader never increments or derives expected revision.
finalOutputRef: Copy of the actual retained reference matching explicit canonical registry entry: consumerId, authorityId, producerId, path, inputDigest, contentDigest, producerReceiptDigest. No reseal.
finalOutputDigest: Actual retained inputDigest, independently checked against serialized WRAPPER byte SHA-256. Not payload.digest, wrapper.contentDigest, producerReceiptDigest or checkpointDigest.
payloadLayer: Existing resolveEvidenceReferencePayload verifies wrapper.payload.digest against payload bytes and checks payload schema. It is not returned as the wrapper digest.
identityValidation: Existing validateCurrentRunEvidenceContext/validateEvidenceLocatorRegistry/locateCurrentRunEvidence, plus exact current block and checkpoint run/source fields.
noMutation: Default canonical reader repairProjection=false; no write, repair, publication, retry, extra lock, reseal or latest selection.
terminalAuthority: Not granted; running canonical checkpoints may retain committed references. Output is facts, not a success/qualification receipt.
